name: The True Masters
summary: Helendis Riverhorn asks you to carry his letter to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire. The message links these two men, though its contents are not given here.

sections.title: A Letter for Lakeshire
sections.body: The road now leads you to Lakeshire, where Magistrate Solomon is to receive Helendis Riverhorn's letter. Carrying it brings the two men into contact; what it says remains for Solomon to learn.

faq.answer: Helendis Riverhorn's letter is addressed to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire.

faq.q: Where do I take Helendis Riverhorn's letter?
faq.answer: Take Helendis Riverhorn's letter to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire.
Helendis Riverhorn is the one whose letter you carry to Magistrate Solomon.

attribution: In-game quest text: The True Masters
